shots.detail_en: Night, Lu Changhong's tiny flat: a white envelope slides under the door and stops at his slippers, printed only with the words 'TOP FLOOR'.
Changhong opens the envelope; a gold-plated room card slides onto the table and rolls half a circle before stopping.
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Close-up of the pocket watch chain: the watch runs one minute behind the wall clock, two second hands one tick apart.
Father's notebook open at the page 'the tape lies, volume never does'; the room card presses on the words.
Lianhua Tower at night; one elevator shoots upward, floor numbers lighting up one by one toward the top.
shots.sub: 旁白：父亲说，山脚的人看热闹，山顶的人——看人。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Elevator opens: top-floor office lit by one lamp, a cigar ember glowing, Xiong Tiancheng's back against the glass wall.
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Changhong stays standing; Xiong turns around, his smile like mercy.
shots.sub: 熊：打了三年，打进这扇门。年轻人——山顶的椅子，比山腰的掌声凉快。
shots.speaker: CH+XIONG

shots.detail_en: Close-up of the empty high-back leather chair, its armrests polished shiny; Xiong's voice off-screen.
shots.sub: 长：我不坐你的椅子。 熊（画外）：椅子不姓熊。它只认——坐上来的人。
shots.speaker: CH+XIONG

shots.detail_en: Mirror-abyss anchor: on the glass curtain wall, the reflections of Changhong and Xiong stand shoulder to shoulder, neon light passing through both bodies.
Xiong clicks a remote: a giant screen lights up with a 1993 data interface (green vintage UI, only the year and abstract waveforms visible).
shots.sub: 熊：想看 93 年 6 月 17 日，最后十分钟吗？
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Green waveforms reflected in Changhong's contracting pupils.
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Blast point: Xiong slides an unmarked archive envelope across the long table.
shots.sub: 熊：帮我护一只票，护三天。市场惩罚的是贪婪的人——我只是市场的一只手。你，可以做另一只。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Changhong's hand presses on the envelope, knuckles going white; Xiong's voice off-screen.
shots.sub: 长：护谁的？ 熊（画外）：问路的，上不了山。
shots.speaker: CH+XIONG

shots.detail_en: Changhong pulls the envelope away and turns toward the elevator.
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Man Cang's home: his father counts out a stack of deposit slips from an iron box and pushes them to Man Cang.
shots.sub: 满仓爹：六万。爹的养老钱，跟陆先生干——替爹出这口气。
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: The father's calloused palm presses on the deposit slips like pressing down half a life.
shots.sub: 满仓：爹！这钱您留着抓药——我不全仓，您倒先全仓了！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Next day after close: Shen Hongli reconciles accounts, capital flow on her screen shifts steeply.
shots.sub: 红：他的账……开始像另一个人的账了。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Hongli lines up two-year-old ledgers side by side: the two curves nearly overlap.
shots.sub: 红：庄家式的呼吸……他在学谁？
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Outside the Lianhua server room, Xiong Wei watches the light of his father's office burning late.
shots.sub: 熊伟：父亲的门，十年来第一次为一个散户开。变量接入，开始记录。
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Data streams across Xiong Wei's lenses; a tag pops up: 'CH: weight up'.
The rooftop (the 1993 spot): Changhong stands in night wind clutching the envelope.
shots.sub: 长：爸，K 线画到最后一根，才看得见握笔的手。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Black frame end card for next episode.
shots.sub: 他要护的那只票——名字里有个『华』字。
shots.card: 他要护的那只票——名字里有个『华』字。
